name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
title: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd - 532540 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 constant-currency revenue grew 1.2% QoQ after three sequential gains, FY26 CC revenue fell 2.4%, and margin reached 25% with no hard capacity signal; supply-side read is neutral, demand improving modestly.

triggers.label: Q4 CC revenue +1.2% QoQ
triggers.quote: We delivered a strong 1.2% sequentially on a constant currency (CC) basis

triggers.label: Mid/large client bands added after ~2 years
triggers.quote: every revenue band saw healthy additions this quarter after a gap of about 2 years

triggers.label: Realisations improved ~40 bps
triggers.quote: an improvement in realizations driven by continued focus on value-led delivery

triggers.label: FY27 margin 'move towards 26%' long-term
triggers.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.

triggers.label: AI-led deflation offsets revenue
triggers.quote: the deflation in the other part may not matter materially

guidance.value: No numeric guidance; 'regular Q1, regular Q2' seasonality, stronger 1H
guidance.quote: We are looking at a regular Q1, regular Q2 that we are used to seeing

guidance.value: Tighter range, move towards 26% longer term
guidance.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.
in the range of 150 to 200 basis points

red_flags.label: Higher SG&A and external consultant costs
red_flags.quote: Some part of it will see an elevated increase, both in the absolute amount as well as in percentage of revenue.

red_flags.label: AI deflation on legacy revenue
red_flags.quote: the deflation in the other part may not matter materially

evasions.quote: I don't want to put a number, but I would say that, again, as I was telling Sudheer, we are quite positive about FY27
Margins, I will not call out because there would be investments which would be temporary or in the initial phase
